2.0.n: A way to refer to yourself, commonly used by men and boys.

2.1.n: Marks 僕 as the topic: who this sentence is about.

2.2.n: Together with で, this describes how the lessons are conducted.

2.3.n: Marks the medium used for the activity: the internet.

2.4.n: Names the language covered in the lessons.

2.5.n: Links 日本語 to レッスン to specify what the lessons cover.

2.7.n: Marks レッスン as what the speaker conducts.

2.8.n: する becomes して + います; this polite form describes regular work here, not necessarily something happening right now.

0.lit: As for me, online Japanese-language teacher am.
0.tip: 日本語の先生 means a teacher of Japanese; の connects the subject taught to the teacher.

2.lit: As for me, online, Japanese-language lessons am doing.
